description: Evaluates shell and Python scripts (and the shell in workflows, Dockerfiles, Makefiles): underlined issues, quick fixes, hover, score, formatting.
command.analyze.title: Analyze file
command.restart.title: Restart server
config.path: check-script executable (name in PATH or absolute path).
config.profile: Scoring profile (empty: the one from .checkscript.yaml, otherwise default).
config.analyzeOnType: While typing, apply the built-in rules (full analysis happens on open and on save).
config.typingDelay: Typing pause (ms) before the quick analysis.
config.trace: Trace of the exchanges with the server (Output panel).
